description: Ground truth for eval/benchmark.py. 'relevant' maps a file name in sample_docs/ to a grade: 2 = the note that answers the query, 1 = a note that covers the topic in passing. 'type' records why the query is in the set: keyword = shares rare terms with the note (BM25-friendly), natural = a question in ordinary words, paraphrase = deliberately avoids the note's vocabulary (embedding-friendly), cross = more than one note is relevant.
